name: Nettoyage de la voix
description: Removes background noise from the selected audio clips with DeepFilterNet3, a speech-enhancement network that runs on this computer (audio.denoiseVoice). The cleaned audio is written next to the project as a WAV, the clip is pointed at it, and one Undo brings the original back. The model (8 MB, MIT or Apache-2.0) is an optional download: the last entry asks before fetching it.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Nettoyer la voix (léger)
entries.description: Noise reduced by at most 6 dB: keeps the room's feel.

entries.label: Nettoyer la voix (standard)
entries.description: Noise reduced by at most 14 dB: the usual choice for a voice recorded in a noisy place.

entries.label: Nettoyer la voix (fort)
entries.description: As much noise removed as the model finds. Can make a very noisy voice sound processed.

entries.label: Installer le modèle de voix (DeepFilterNet3)
entries.description: Shows the size, source and licence, then downloads the model once you accept.
